visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with bright orange-blonde hair and a cream-colored button-up shirt stands in front of a promotional poster for 'Chainsaw Man'. She smiles widely and holds a white 'POP MART' shopping bag and an 'Arcane' branded blind box toward the camera. (2) A screen graphic appears showing the collection of League of Legends Arcane figurines, including Jinx, Ekko, and others with their names in Chinese. (3) The woman begins unboxing. She pulls out a Jayce figurine; her expression shifts to humorous disappointment. She shows the gold and white armored figure to the camera. (4) In the next phase, she opens another box to reveal a Mel figurine with dark skin and gold armor. She appears frustrated, gesturing with her hands. (5) The screen turns black and white with dramatic swirling graphics as she makes a pouting face. (6) The video cuts to a faster-paced montage where she successfully unboxes Jinx and Vi figurines. She shows off the high detail of Vi's large mechanical gauntlets. (7) She reacts with shock and extreme joy, her eyes wide, as she reveals a rare 'hidden' version of Jinx with a stone/Medusa texture. She brings the figurine close to the lens. (8) She unboxes Viktor, showing his blue and gold mechanical design. (9) Standing in the same indoor location, she speaks directly to the camera, using two-finger peace signs and pointing to text overlays about social media giveaways. (10) A high-quality static photo of the stone-version Jinx figurine on a keyboard background is shown.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice shouting in Mandarin over a driving, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong synth beat. (2) A 'Pop' SFX triggers as the video cuts to a graphic, with the female voice rapidly listing names of characters. (3) A 'Thud' and rustling sound of cardboard occur as the first box is opened. The speaker's tone becomes mock-exasperated and loud as she discovers a duplicate. (4) A short 'Boom' SFX and a distorted vocal effect play as she expresses frustration over another box. (5) A 'Whoosh' SFX leads into a melancholic, slower-tempo musical snippet for the dramatic monochrome section. (6) High-energy screaming and 'Ding' SFX follow as she finds characters she likes. The BGM maintains a constant, energetic 4/4 rhythm. (7) An extreme peak in vocal arousal occurs with high-pitched shrieking as the hidden figure is revealed. Fast-paced chatter follows. (8) The female voice transitions to a professional, instructional tone with lower pitch variability as she explains giveaway rules. (9) The BGM swells in volume at the end, accompanied by a final 'Sparkle' SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Unboxing -> Climax -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the thrill and variable outcomes of unboxing POP MART blind boxes with a fan community, while promoting social media engagement through a giveaway of duplicates.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator is unboxing a specific brand's product and clearly displaying the logo and packaging.
